label: Origin-compatible deletion attacks the necessary concretum through origin-determined access
note: Target: b19ffd92. Mechanism, jointly with origin-determined access 5389a062 only: origin-compatible deletion supplies, for each concrete individual existing at w, a world lacking it whose shared individuals keep near origins; by 5389a062 that world is accessible from w (result 5ef604b9 derives worldwise deletion from the two), contradicting b19ffd92 at w. Without 5389a062 the deletion world need not be accessible and there is no conflict, since ed582cc8 does not mention access. Independent justification: free deletion of individuals limited only by origin essentialism, the analyst's reconstruction of the origin-tolerance account (attribution deferred). Relevance: it locates the conflict with the necessary-concretum routes in the pair (ed582cc8, 5389a062), so a defender of b19ffd92 must reject one of them.
